 About the match
 On this page you can find the FC Porto vs GD Estoril match lineup for Liga Portugal — Round 10 - First Leg, on Saturday 31-10-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. FC Porto lines up in a 4-3-3 led by Costa, while GD Estoril sets up in a 3-4-3 led by Carvalho. FC Porto is led by head coach Francesco Farioli, while GD Estoril is managed by João Batista. The match is played at Estadio do Dragao.
